name: Diana
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 78 Diana: diameter 120.6 ± 2.7 km; JPL's stated reference: IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 120.6 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Diana. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: R. Luther found Diana at Dusseldorf on 15 March 1863.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 120.6 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
